gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-trispace: Red Hat Display draws marker-thick lines with daylight in every curve. Trispace answers with sparse, widely set letters whose curves open outward, so the heading carries the punch while the body simply gives the words room.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-tsukimi-rounde: Tsukimi Rounded reads clean and softly rounded, its forms like open parentheses with parallel stroke edges. Red Hat Display brings a bolder, marker-like line above it, and the two sit together with a friendly, modern ease.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-tuffy: Marker-bold up top, pencil-light below. Red Hat Display holds its line at a constant width, while Tuffy looks sketched with one unpressed pencil and a widely parted s, giving the pair a relaxed, contemporary feel.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-urbanist: A marker-like line of constant width, with daylight inside each curve, defines Red Hat Display. It makes the louder statement, while Urbanist, with its broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut, does the quieter work of carrying the sentences.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-varela: Varela reads like a plain sans with a wide-mouthed c and a t whose crossbar matches its stem. Red Hat Display sits above it with a marker-bold, contemporary line, and the two feel friendly but confident side by side.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-varela-round: Red Hat Display keeps one marker-like line width throughout, with visible daylight inside every curve and a bold, contemporary stance. Varela Round follows with same-width strokes framing its counters and wide-mouthed lowercase rounds, smoothing the page out.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-varta: Red Hat Display is bold and contemporary, with a flat gray hum of constant line weight. And Varta, a plain sans with big open eyes on every e and a, gives that heading a softer, more spacious companion.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-vazirmatn: Vazirmatn reads approachable and modern, with a wide-open s that never tightens. And Red Hat Display, its bowls free of any thinning at the sides, keeps a longer passage feeling inviting rather than dense.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-wix-madefor-di: Wix Madefor Display brings gently flared curve ends that stay apart, giving a neutral, contemporary texture under Red Hat Display. Try giving the body a bit more size.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-wix-madefor-te: Drafting-pen boldness, then easy reading. Red Hat Display holds one constant nib width in thin-looking letters, and Wix Madefor Text, a plain sans with open terminals, picks up the sentences without any fuss.
